lines.speaker: Helper
lines.text: Use the WASD keys to move your character.

lines.speaker: Helper
lines.text: Use the LMB and RMB to fire your arm weapons, Q and E keys to fire your shoulder weapons, and R key to reload your weapons.

lines.speaker: Helper
lines.text: Use the Shift key to dodge enemy attacks!

lines.speaker: Helper
lines.text: You also have abilities in your head, torso and legs, Press Tab, Ctrl, and Space to activate each of them!

lines.speaker: Helper
lines.text: That's it for the tutorial, now go out there and finish the quest!
